turns.question: What is the address of Union Station in Washington, DC?
turns.shown:
Union Station's address is **50 Massachusetts Avenue NE, Washington, DC 20002**.

- Union Station's own contact page lists 50 Massachusetts Ave., NE, Washington, D.C. 20002. [1]
- Amtrak lists the same street address, with the longer ZIP+4 of 20002-4214. [2]
- One third-party bus listing shows ZIP 20001. That looks like an outlier, and the official sources agree on 20002.

The station sits on Columbus Circle, near the U.S. Capitol grounds. Amtrak says pick-up and drop-off is at the Massachusetts Avenue exit. [2] If you're driving or using a ride-share app, you may want to check the exact entrance on a map.

Sources
[1] Contact Us — https://www.unionstationdc.com/contact-us/ (search result age: 168 days ago)
[2] Washington, DC - Union Station (WAS) — https://www.amtrak.com/stations/was (search result age: 285 days ago)
